text.8:59: And let not those who disbelieve suppose that they can outstrip (Allah's Purpose). Lo! they cannot escape.
text.35:44: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.
text.72:12: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
